description: This file defines various React functional components that render SVG icons for use in a web UI, including icons like search, arrows, warning, attachment, check, clock, and others. It also imports CSS files for styling.

methods.name: spacer
methods.description: Returns a span element styled as an icon spacer with fixed width and height.

methods.name: search
methods.description: Returns an SVG icon representing a search magnifying glass.

methods.name: downArrow
methods.description: Returns an SVG icon representing a downward arrow.

methods.description: Returns an SVG icon representing a rightward arrow.

methods.name: warning
methods.description: Returns an SVG icon representing a warning symbol.

methods.description: Returns an SVG icon representing an attachment/paperclip.

methods.description: Returns an SVG icon representing a cross or close symbol.

methods.name: check

methods.name: skip
